# getSchema

<link-summary>Returns the schema of a sheet, stored or inferred from its contents.</link-summary>

<web-summary>getSchema() — Returns the schema of a sheet, stored or inferred from its contents. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function getSchema(sheet: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet): SheetSchema | null;
```

A schema describes the columns: their names, their types and the row the names live in. When `insertSchema` has stored one on the sheet, that is what comes back.

When nothing was stored, the sheet is read and a schema is inferred from the header row and the values below it. The result carries `inferred: true` in that case, so a caller can tell a description that was declared from one that was guessed.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                 | Description           |
| :-------- | :----------------------------------- | :-------------------- |
| `sheet`   | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet` | The sheet to work on. |

## Returns

`SheetSchema | null` — the schema, or `null` when the sheet holds nothing to describe.

## Throws

| Exception               | Condition                          |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `InvalidSheetException` | the first argument is not a sheet. |

## Examples

### Reading a schema

```javascript
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

const schema = getSchema(sheet);

schema?.columns.map((column) => column.name);
```
